safe_initialization.capability_context: SAFE_CONTEXT_VALUE returned when context is missing.
safe_initialization.capability_graph: createSafeGraph() builds a complete empty graph and catches graph construction failures.
safe_initialization.module_access: safeModuleAccess() normalizes missing module access into empty arrays, unknown access, and async no-op refresh.
safe_initialization.adapter_access: safeAdapterAccess() normalizes missing adapter/provider access into empty arrays, unknown access, and async no-op refresh.
safe_initialization.registry: registryItems defaults to [], registryUnavailable defaults to true, registryError defaults to SAFE_REGISTRY_ERROR.
safe_initialization.live_gate: readiness, productionReadiness, policies, and liveGateErrors use safe fallback reports/errors on first render and failure.

fallback_ui_state.visible_surface: Sidebar footer now shows Loading workspace, Degraded mode, or Fallback mode.

defensive_guards: useFrontendCapabilityState() returns SAFE_CONTEXT_VALUE instead of throwing when provider context is missing.
refresh() uses Promise.allSettled() so one provider refresh failure cannot block render.
loadCapabilityState() uses try/catch/finally and always clears local loading.
graph construction is wrapped in try/catch and falls back to createSafeGraph().
array inputs are normalized through safeArray() before graph construction.
no async request is required before first render; provider emits safe fallback state immediately.
